title: Fuliginous
summary: FULIG'INOUS, adjective [Latin fuligineus, fuliginosus, from fuligo, soot.] 1. Pertaining to soot; sooty; dark; dusky. 2. Pertaining to smoke; resembling smoke; dusky.
